AZ = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
az = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

encrypted = "cvpbPGS{abg_gbb_onq_bs_n_ceboyrz}"
s = ""
for x in encrypted:
    if x in AZ:
        s += AZ[(AZ.index(x)+13)%len(AZ)]

        s += az[(az.index(x)+13)%len(az)]
